import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# In obs_0051: cam at (-0.77, 2.0), heading = 270 deg
img51 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0051.png')
mask51 = (img51[:,:,2] > 120) & (img51[:,:,0] < 50)
y51, x51 = np.where(mask51)
print('obs_0051: pot base bottom y =', y51.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(x51))
wx_p, wy_p, z_p = ray_ground(np.mean(x51), y51.max(), -0.77, 2.0, 270)
print(f'Plant pot from obs_0051: ({wx_p:.2f}, {wy_p:.2f}), dist={z_p:.2f}')

# Blue cylinder / stool / table on right in obs_0051:
# Notice blue object on the bottom right of obs_0051!
blue51 = (img51[:,:,0] > 150) & (img51[:,:,2] < 50)
yb51, xb51 = np.where(blue51)
